author: reek
body: The residual case. The first guard looked for "EFI PART" at sector 1, so it caught a GPT disk and missed a disk carrying only an MBR partition table -- which was still written straight through, and its partition table still eaten, by a store that believed it had been made safe. A bare FAT volume with no partition table at all lands here too: its boot sector ends in the same two bytes, and the store overwriting a filesystem is the same damage as the store overwriting a partition table.
